programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy can't believe it: he has just swallowed a spoonful of his favorite food, chocolate spread, and he hates it! How could that be possible? And yet, when he swiped the jar from the Lemmings, they seemed to be enjoying it immensely. A quick investigation reveals that the Lemmings added a dash of lemon juice to the jar to give the spread a sharper taste. And they intend to jazz up the rest of the stock as well!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the fondness of his beloved she-bear for meditation. To seduce her, he sets out to prove to her that he too can attain the Zen attitude. This demands practice, of course, but it especially demands lots of willpower and concentration to get rid of the rowdy Lemmings without losing one's temper.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a super-secret Canadian Army prototype which resembles a simple computer keyboard. It has only several command keys: select, cut and paste, and delete, but the keys act directly on surrounding elements... as well as on living beings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with a bowling game they found in the Ranger's storeroom. Grizzy hastens to destroy the pins to ensure his peace and quiet. But the Lemmings discover a remote-control device that can modify the ball's weight. By setting it on maximum, the ball could knock over much more than pins: furniture, a bear and even a log cabin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: After the rains, to the great delight of the Lemmings, strange bouncing mushrooms have sprouted in the yard. To put an end to the Lemmings' noisy games - which prevent Grizzy from enjoying his peace and quiet - Grizzy tramples the mushrooms. Only to realize that each crushed mushroom frees a cloud of spores that instantly creates... a bunch of identical mushrooms.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have laid hand on special magnets which turn any object they are stuck to into flying objects. Grizzy bears the consequences and is ejected out of the cabin on his couch, which has turned into a flying-couch. Upon landing, Grizzy discovers by chance that the magnet stuck to his forehead enables him to fly like Peter Pan.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: With a lion-tamer's whip, a sugar bowl and lots of work, the Lemmings have successfully trained a caribou to go through their obstacle course. Grizzy cannot help but admire the performance. He decides to steal their idea, and the caribou, to create his own circus act and impress his lovely she-bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy happens onto the electronic version of the Ranger Lemming toy which is capable of reproducing the movements one teaches it, like a smart robot. Grizzy immediately grasps the potential of a robot that could perform chores with rapidity and precision, but the Lemmings would rather teach it to dance.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Ranger's cabin is equipped with an ultra-effective pest detector capable of sensing the presence of an intruder, then chasing it out by emitting a wave that instructs the creature's brain to leave at once. Grizzy and the Lemmings are no longer able to stay inside, until they discover that the box's remote-control device allows you to select which type of animal will be spared or targeted by the wave.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy finds himself unwillingly caught up in a race between two teams of Lemmings. When he understands the stakes, he tries to win but loses. Grizzy has his pride: he wants a rematch. He decides to build his own racing machine to challenge the Lemmings' soapbox.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have placed giant remote-controlled hydraulic jacks under the cabin to transform it into a life-sized rolling ball game. Grizzy, who in inclined to seasickness, tries to put things back in place. The cabin tips over into empty space.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet – but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless – he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm – yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket makes Mr Bean drive her to the hospital to get her ingrown toenail seen to and asks him to wait. Mr Bean gets bored, and on a wander around the hospital he finds a spare doctor’s outfit with stethoscope – great Teddy - I’ll give you a check-up! But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: It's back to basics as Specs attempts to catch Lamput with a net. Not being much good at anything at all physical, Specs ends up whacking himself on his own noggin. The blow shakes loose what little ability Specs had to function as an adult. He's transformed into a wailing infant who requires 24 hour care from his devoted... parents? Skinny and Lamput have to learn on the job. Taking care of a baby is hard. Especially if it's a giant annoying one.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings create a customized hang-glider using a supermarket shopping cart for the nacelle and a ventilator as an engine. Their aerobatics fascinate the she-bear that Grizzy is in love with, which gives him the idea of replacing the shopping cart with a double-seat and inviting his beloved for a sky promenade. But confiscating a wing in mid-flight is not within the reach of just any old bear.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: The Docs prove their inventing skills by coming up with an age-altering time-ray. This breakthrough could change the world. If they used it for something other than chasing Lamput. Obsessed much, fellas? Wildly shooting their time-ray off in public causes a not-unsurprising amount of chaos, until the local law enforcement gets caught in the cross-fire. Looks like the Specs and Skinny are gonna be in jail till they get old the normal way.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Jon, Min, and Miguel can’t wait to explore their new home base! But their welcome party takes a turn when the island’s most feared predator crashes the scene: Big Rex! Uncle Jack ushers them into safety in Dino Explorers HQ! Unbeknown to the ranchers, a duo of rascally compy's have stolen the HQ's system key throwing everything into chaos.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers take the Jungle Jetter on an underwater joyride—but their fun comes to a screeching halt when they catch the eye of Thunderfin, the island’s ill-tempered mosasaurus! With jaws snapping and tail thrashing, Thunderfin charges after them, forcing the kids to dive into the shadows of a nearby cave for cover!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean loves Halloween and prepares to give the neighbourhood kids some tricks and treats they won’t forget. But when Mr Bean gets carried away with his spooky pranks he becomes the target of even more fiendish tricks from his neighbours the Bruisers.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is painting a picture of Teddy when he accidently squirts some green paint onto his brown wallpaper. Oh no! Bean needs to redecorate his room fast but ends up painting all the walls a garish lime green instead of brown. He’s so terrified of Mrs Wicket finding out that when he goes to bed he has some very weird nightmares – with a rather sickly ending.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean’s Birthday dinner gets off on the wrong foot when he and Teddy are made to take the worst table at a swanky restaurant. The evening is further ruined by a self-obsessed movie star at the next table. After a swim in the lobster tank, Mr. Bean unwittingly cooks up sweet revenge in the kitchen.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: With Baby Owl bored to tears, the Baby Lemmings have invented a new game: figurines made from acorns. With them, they create a kind of small village in their own playmobile style. Baby Owl would like to play with them, but clumsily destroys the whole village. Thinking she's done it on purpose, the Baby Lemmings run away from her in the hope of being able to play in peace.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings become friends and play with crickets. Baby Moose hates these bugs, which terrify him. Baby Moose hides to avoid running into the insects, but he comes face to face with a cricket that has been thrown off while playing with the lemmings. Panic-stricken, Baby Moose tries to put these threatening pests out of action, but after a blunder he finds himself adrift on the water with a cricket!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby chipmunk has a collection of pretty gems. But when she loses a round one and it rolls past the Baby lemmings, they get the idea of organising a marble run. They collect lots of objects, cut them to make them spherical and... And off they go! But when the Baby chipmunk realises she's lost her stone, she wants it back. And when she sees all the new stones the Baby lemmings have collected, she wants them all back! But the baby lemmings have no intention of stopping their mad marble race through the forest!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs accidentally intercepts a top secret bag intended for a secret agent. Now a spy is hot on Bugs' tail! It's a matter of national security!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: After a run-in with Bugs Yosemite Sam's cell phone gets scratched. He decides it's time to upgrade but little does he know that Bugs is there to help.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Rock Hardcase a fitness guru shows up to pull a fast one on the unsuspecting animals of the forest. Bugs proves to be an extremely difficult customer.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Squeaks stumble across a potion called Grow Fastums in the woods. Squeaks disregards Bugs warnings and takes the potion as his own wreaking havoc throughout the forest.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang gets caught up in international espionage and intrigue when they cross paths with British secret agent, Jenny Vex, and must help her complete her dangerous mission of stopping an evil mercenary called Minus from killing breakfast.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred's worst nightmare comes true when an evil spirit possesses the Mystery Machine and turns his beloved van into an unrelenting monster out to destroy him and the gang before they can solve the mystery.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Nipping to the shops for a few provisions becomes a nightmare when a mile-long shopping list from his landlady and a clapped out trolley with a wonky wheel conspire to ruin his day. Subscribing to the theory that bigger is better, he constructs his own shopping trolley incorporating a petrol mower, pram wheels and an extra pair of hydraulic hands.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean inadvertently causes an accident which prevents Irma taking the scout troop to Big Bear’s Scout Camp. With the scout master and mini bus out of action Mr Bean steps in to save the day. As temporary scoutmaster Mr Bean enjoys his new role but his obsessive badge collecting wins him no friends within the group.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Spike leaves Tom in charge of his boy Tyke only to discover upon his return that Tyke now behaves more like a cat than a dog.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Tom falls into a manhole and finds a magic cloak that turns him into King of the Catacombs.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Forced into driving a racecar created by evil Dr. Otto, Tom terrorizes the village mice until Jerry Van Mouseling comes to their rescue.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is serving food at a diner. Jerry and Tuffy sneak in and eat the food. Tom tries to chase them out of the diner and in the end they all share a delicious treat.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: When they find an old book on traditional Japanese origami, the Lemmings churn out paper birds to play gliding games. Grizzy realizes that he could make the gorgeous butterfly on the cover for his beloved she-bear. But to make the Lemmings bow to his authority, he will first have to become a true origami master.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are all lined up on the couch to watch a cartoon film where a mouse plays nasty tricks on a cat. Grizzy, who has decided to take his nap, switches off the TV and confiscates the batteries of the remote control to make sure they can't switch their program back on. But is it wise to frustrate a gang of Lemmings who've been inspired by a gag-filled cartoon?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Once again, Grizzy shows the Lemmings that they just don't measure up to him physically and that the last jar of chocolate spread is for the strongest. The Lemmings find a way around this by increasing the power of a lamp that accelerates plant growth and instantly expand themselves to... bear size.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay their hands on a full crate of chocolate spread, which they hide somewhere behind Grizzy's back. And since the Lemmings are both prudent and cunning, it's impossible to surprise them when they pay a visit to their secret hoard. Until the day Grizzy discovers a magic ring that enables him to take on the appearance of a Lemming.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is persuaded that he's discovered the ultimate gadget for good living: a pair of connected glasses for watching TV in panoramic view, with all sorts of indicators, namely an intrusion warning signal. There is only one real drawback: the speedometer function which the Lemmings adore.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings clamor for their turn to play with the ranger's mobile phone, but Grizzy isn't in the sharing mood. And he's very talented at flattening anything that comes near, without looking up from his game. The Lemmings invent an implacable protection system which should enable them to recover the mobile in complete safety.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Magnetikus guides a giant meteor toward Kaboom City. Astroturbo, a newcomer, must stop it before it ends Kaboom City.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When all of the Batwheels (except for Bam) mysteriously disappear, Bam enlists the help of A.D.A.M, the original Batmobile, to help save his friends. Along the way, Bam comes to appreciate the old-school mobile's different crimefighting style as they team up to take on the Legion of Zoom.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Much to everyone’s surprise, Bam is secretly afraid of the dark. When Poison Ivy knocks out all the power in Gotham, Bam must conquer his fears to stop her.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Redbird tries his hand at espionage as “V-8, the Super-Spy”, he quickly realizes he's gotten in over his head, so Redbird teams up with Bibi to save the Amusement Mile from Dr. Spy!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Bibi has a terrible no-good day after she keeps messing up and lets Joker get away. She doesn’t think he can help Batgirl anymore, but a “bad today” doesn’t mean it’ll be a “bad tomorrow.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders face underwater challenges as they build a sea school for Moxie Manatee.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Moxie Manatee hires The Looney Builders to build an obstacle course for the Sandy Shells Preschool Games, but Lola isn’t listening to her crew.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build a party boat for Mac and Tosh when Tweety accidentally makes a mistake but doesn’t ask for help.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders try to help Winston Whale by building him a mail truck, but Winston is used to working alone.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Lola leads the crew in washing their vehicles only to discover she mixed up the job assignments.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean fancies a game of golf so he creates his own golf course inside his flat and invites Irma to join him for a round. Their somewhat eccentric game takes them from sitting room to bathroom and through Mrs Wicket’s flat as they battle to be the winner of the First Bean Open Championship.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: A crafty cat burglar is causing alarm and concern throughout the town with a series of daring rooftop robberies. After Mrs Wicket’s house is burgled and Bean has his wallet stolen he decides the only way to deal with this cunning housebreaker is to don a costume and become a superhero (like the ones in his favourite comic book). But Super Bean soon finds he has his hands full helping to rescue cats stuck in trees and old ladies with their spilled shopping.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines – and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet – but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless – he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm – yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have found an Amerindian eagle amulet that endows he who wears it with the powers of a bird of prey. Grizzy would like to impress his beloved she-bear by soaring majestically through the sky. But to confiscate the magic totem from the Lemmings, who are now as sharp as eagles, Grizzy will have to use the cunning... of a puma.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with the ranger's electric guitar and the cabin walls tremble with their experimental rock. Just as Grizzy is about to destroy the instrument, he realizes it can make harmonious sounds too. Will this be enough to seduce the she-bear he's in love with?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: To finally be on an equal footing with Grizzy's imposing build and throw their own weight around in the cabin, the Lemmings decide to wear a blow-up sumotori costume.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover an ancient Amerindian table with the power to show you past events. They relive their prehistoric ancestors' first confrontations, and learn that chocolate spread was invented long, long ago.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover an old book of magic spells with a formula that enables one to take on the appearance of any other creature. The Lemmings have the bright idea of transforming one their kin into a double of the she-bear Grizzy is madly in love with in order to trick him. How could Grizzy refuse to give his jar of chocolate spread to his sweetheart?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: When Grizzy propels the Lemmings out of the log cabin perched on the Great Wall of China, the critters land on a small traditional house in a bamboo forest where they discover a box filled with fortune cookies. One Lemming gets super lucky after eating one. Armed with their magic cookies, the Lemmings set out to confront Grizzy. But each cookie represents a power… or a curse!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings love sesame nougat but Grizzy, who adores this treat too, steals their box. Quite upset, the rodents search for more, in vain. Instead, they discover the art of energy points in an old Chinese medicine book. Determined to recover their sweets regardless of the cost, the Lemmings activate Grizzy's vital points and the bear finds himself completely blocked. Thanks to the book, Grizzy frees himself and learns to master energies in turn.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After a game that ends abruptly, the Lemmings fall onto the roof of a temple where they discover drawings of Tai Chi movements. When carried out, the exercises generate a ball of energy! The Lemmings test out the sequence of movements on… Grizzy, until he is evicted from the cabin and falls onto the temple in turn. His fall unveils a new sequence of movements on a fresco that could create an even stronger energy flow!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After being thrown out of the log cabin by Grizzy, the Lemmings find a dragon statue with a mysterious stone in a temple. Touching the stone makes a fleeting tattoo appear on their bellies, temporarily endowing them with the mastery of Shaolin Kung Fu. The Lemmings return to the cabin and uproot Grizzy with ease! But Grizzy has not said his last word and manages to get hold of the magic stone.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the tablet. During their scuffle, they knock over an army crate which falls into the middle of the bamboo forest surrounding the cabin. Alerted by the noise, a peace missionary panda comes out of the forest and tries to calm down the worked-up adversaries. But will the limitless strategies of Grizzy and the Lemmings get the better of the panda's patience?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings create a shadow puppet show where seven papercut lemmings confront a bear over a jar of Yummy chocolate spread. The Lemmings in the audience are super enthusiastic, but Grizzy is outraged by the treatment inflicted upon the bear. He decides to intervene and equips the paper bear with an armor and saber! The Lemmings retort with ninja effigies of themselves and mount an attack to recover the coveted jar of Yummy spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: As Grizzy relaxes in the massage chair, a cloud drifts in front of the sun, immediately stopping the electricity supply in the log cabin. The voltage drops continue, even though the sky seems clear now. Grizzy looks out the window and a dragon appears on the horizon! Once over his initial fright, the bear realizes that it's only a kite flown by the Lemmings – using the electricity from the cabin they have rerouted!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy dismantles the toboggan built by the Lemmings in the log cabin and reemploys the bamboo sticks to build a jacuzzi. When the Lemmings discover the bear's piece of work, they imagine a giant waterpark dominated by an immense waterslide. Anticipating the Lemmings' desire, Grizzy tries to barricade himself inside but the rodents manage to eject him from the cabin. The bear comes back, protected by a super bamboo armor…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize a drone race throughout the cabin. Grizzy, who was on the verge of falling asleep, interrupts the competition but must contend with the rodents' reprisals. Thrown out of the cabin, the bear falls onto a temple dedicated to the Monkey King. He appropriates the statue's powers, operating a magic cloud by remote control. Grizzy settles in on the cloud and wins the race before the Lemmings. But a cloud that flies that fast can only arouse lust…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: To trick Grizzy's vigilance and steal the TV, the Lemmings, disguised as traditional Chinese dancers, perform a number that leaves the bear flabbergasted. The rodents take advantage of their diversion to carry off the TV set on their airborne craft made of Chinese umbrellas. But before they can escape with their bounty, Grizzy recovers the screen. Ever as determined, the Lemmings come back after upgrading their vessel.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Halloween, so the crew decorates their garage for the Looneyburg Trick-Or-Treaters.

programme.desc: Moley must learn to Molerskate for the Great Mole Roll skating competition and discovers his parents have a hidden talent.

programme.desc: When an egg rolls into Moletown and a duckling hatches, Moley must play momma to the baby duck until they can find its home.

programme.title: Ledynmetis. Žemynų atsiradimas
programme.desc: Ar žinote, kaip iš tikrųjų susiformavo žemynai? Viskas prasidėjo nuo mažytės voveriuko Skreto gilės. Menkas bakstelėjimas ledyno paviršiuje baigėsi kontinentų atsiskyrimu. Po šio geografinio perversmo Mamutas Menis, tigras Diego, tinginys Sidas ir jo močiutė atsidūrė vidury vandenynų išlaikomi tik menkos ledo lyties. Bičiuliai darys viską, kad išgelbėtų savo kailius ir susitiktų kitus draugus bei šeimos narius. Kelionėje jų laukia neatrastos žemės, egzotiška gamta ir nematytais gyvūnais apgyvendintas piratų laivas! Kompanijai pavyks pasprukti nuo užpuolikų, bet šie bandys herojus pavyti ir atkeršyti. Įspūdingi nuotykiai įtrauks visą šeimą, o filmas bus puiki geografijos pamoka mažiesiems ir linksma pramoga suaugusiems. Filmą įgarsino žinomi šalies žmonės: Rimas Šapauskas (Manfredas), Arūnas Sakalauskas (Sidas), Dainius Svobonas (Diegas), Evelina Kauklienė (Elė), Džiugas Siaurusaitis (Krešas), Algis Dainavičius (Edis), Irmantas Jankaitis (Kapitonas Gutas), Elvyra Žebertavičiūtė (Močiutė), Oneida Kunsunga (Persikutė), Agne Šataitė (Šira).

programme.title: Ledynmetis. Susidūrimas
programme.desc: Išdykęs voveriukas Skretas ir vėl pridarys bėdų. Savo išsvajotą gilę jis randa įšalusioje skraidančioje lėkštėje ir bandydamas ją ištraukti iš ledo pajudina svirtį bei netikėtai išskrenda į kosmosą. Ten Skretas vėl neapsieina be nuotykių – prisidirba tiek, kad Žemės link pažyra daugybė meteorų. Šios „krentančios žvaigždės“ Žemėje gyvenantiems gyvūnams laimės neatneš. Jie turės kuo skubiau ieškoti, kur pasislėpti. Per mamutų Menio ir Elės vestuvių metines meteorai įbaugina susirinkusius svečius, tampa aišku, kad romantikos čia nebus, nors vestuvėms ruošiasi ir jų dukra, apie šeimos pagausėjimą galvoja Diegas, tik Sidas jaučiasi vienišas. Tad saugodami savo gyvybes Menis, Elė, Sidas, Diegas ir kiti palieka namus ir leidžiasi į ilgą kelionę, kurioje bus pavojų, rizikos, tačiau netrūks ir juoko, atradimų bei naujų, spalvingų draugų!

Per mamutų Menio ir Elės vestuvių metines meteorai įbaugina susirinkusius svečius, tampa aišku, kad romantikos čia nebus, nors vestuvėms ruošiasi ir jų dukra, apie šeimos pagausėjimą galvoja Diegas, tik Sidas jaučiasi vienišas. Tad saugodami savo gyvybes Menis, Elė, Sidas, Diegas ir kiti palieka namus ir leidžiasi į ilgą kelionę, kurioje bus pavojų, rizikos, tačiau netrūks ir juoko, atradimų bei naujų, spalvingų draugų!

programme.title: Bjaurusis aš 2
programme.desc: Kol buvęs užkietėjęs piktadarys Gru pratinasi prie šeimyninio gyvenimo ir bando sąžiningai pelnytis iš uogienės verslo, pavagiama slaptoji Arkties laboratorija. Kovos su niekšais sąjunga nusprendžia, kad jai reikia savo žmogaus, ir pasamdo besispyriojantį Gru jiems padėti. Kartu su ekscentriška Kovos su niekšais sąjungos agente Liusi Vaild Gru sutaria, kad jo pagrindinis įtariamasis yra žuvusiu laikomas užkietėjęs niekšas El Mačo, kurio nepilnametis sūnus taip pat turi ketinimų dėl Gru vyresnės dukters Margo. Akivaizdžiai apakintas perdėtos savo vaikų apsaugos ir vis didėjančio potraukio Liusei, Gru eina klaidingu keliu net tuomet, kai jo pakalikai tyliai vienas po kito pagrobiami neaiškiems piktavalių tikslams...

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Noored kangelased
programme.desc: Põnev sari, kus lapsed võistlevad kahes suures väljakutses, mis on inspireeritud tõestisündinud kangelasteost.

programme.title: Andy metsikud seiklused
programme.desc: Andy ja Kipi metsikud seiklused viivad nad üle maailma veidrate ja imeliste loomade otsinguile.

programme.title: Hirmus ajalugu
programme.desc: See on energiline, üllatav ja tavapäratu kujutlus ajaloo kõige jubedamatest, kuid samas naljakamatest sündmustest. Muserdavatest maailmasõdadest ja kurvast keskajast võikate viikingite ning kihvtide kreeklasteni. Ajalugu pole kunagi olnud nii ulakas.

programme.title: Andy reisiseiklused
programme.desc: Andy, Jen ja Scout reisivad oma keskkonnasõbraliku masinaga mööda maailma ja avastavad looduse saladusi ning loomade uskumatut käitumist.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Briti parim noor pagar
programme.desc: Kuulsaima küpsetussaate variant noorte meistritega. 9 - 13aastased noored annavad endast kõik, et saada oma oskuste ja originaalsete retseptidega maa parimaks pagariks.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Loomade jutud

programme.title: Meilei nėra recepto
programme.desc: Darbšti ir maloni visiems aplinkiniams Paz Roble patiria siaubingą vyro išdavystę. Prasiskolinęs sutuoktinis vietoj išpirkos nusprendžia skolininkams atiduoti savo naujagimę dukrą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Nepažabojama dvasia
programme.desc: Mažoji Laki Preston auga globojama tetos Koros. Padykusi mergaitė savo nesenkančia energija ir charakteriu yra nepaprastai panaši į velionę mamą. Bebaimė žirgų kaskadininkė Milagro tikrai būtų jautusi didelį pasididžiavimą savo dukrele. Deja, dėl beprotiško judrumo ir nuolatinės rizikos susižeisti, Laki su teta galiausiai privalo palikti miestą ir persikraustyti į tėvų gimtinę – Miradero miestelį, kuriame iki šiol gyvena mergaitės tėvas Džimas.Laki yra labai nepatenkinta naujais namais. Juk šis miestelis toks nuobodus ir tylus! Viskas pasikeičia po pažinties su dviem bendraamžėmis ir laukiniu mustangu Dvasiumi. Sužinojusios, kad beširdis žirgų tramdytojas ketina pagauti Dvasių ir parduoti jį aukcione, trys draugės imasi mustango gelbėjimo operacijos.

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou
programme.desc: Nestokojant puikaus humoro čia kalbinami žymūs Lietuvos žmonės, netikėtais kampais atskleidžiant jų portretus, skamba gyvo garso pasirodymai, laidos svečiai atlieka netikėčiausias užduotis.

programme.title: Briusterio milijonai
programme.desc: Nevykėlis beisbolo žaidėjas Briusteris netikėtai sužino, kad mirė jo giminaitis. Pasirodo, šis buvo turtuolis ir paliko Briusteriui visą savo kapitalą. Tačiau turčius buvo tikras keistuolis, todėl Briusteris, norėdamas užvaldyti milžiniškus pinigus, turi per 30 dienų išleisti 30 milijonų. Manote, lengva iššvaistyti tiek pinigų? Visai nelengva, ypač kai niekam nė žodeliu negali prasitarti, iš kur juos gavai ir kodėl taip išlaidauji...

programme.title: Žudiko asmens sargybinis
programme.desc: Garsus asmens sargybinis Maiklas Birsas (akt. Ryan Reynolds) susigadino reputaciją, kai jo saugotas Japonijos ginklų prekeivis buvo nušautas. Dabar Maiklas užsiima smulkiais darbeliais, tad kai pasitaiko proga imtis stambaus užsakymo ir susigrąžinti garbę, jis negali atsisakyti. Užduotis – lydėti Interpolo saugomą žudiką, kurio liudijimas padėtų sugauti baltarusių mafijos bosą Vladislavą Duchovičių (akt. Gary Oldmanas). Jį tereikia pervežti iš Mančesterio į Hagą, Olandijoje. Užduotis gal ir nesunki, bet Maiklas nežino, kad kartą smogiką lydėję tarptautinės grupės agentai jau buvo išžudyti ir kad tas nusikaltėlis yra Darius Kinkaidas (akt. Samuel L. Jackson) – jo senas priešas. Tačiau siekiant atgauti gerą reputaciją, gal verta kuriam laikui pamiršti praeities nesutarimus? Šįkart saugomasis vertas savo sargybinio ir jų duetas pažers ne tik pavojingų ir juokingų scenų!

programme.desc: Mažoji Laki Preston auga globojama tetos Koros. Padykusi mergaitė savo nesenkančia energija ir charakteriu yra nepaprastai panaši į velionę mamą. Deja, dėl beprotiško judrumo ir nuolatinės rizikos susižeisti, Laki su teta galiausiai privalo palikti miestą ir persikraustyti į tėvų gimtinę – Miradero miestelį, kuriame iki šiol gyvena mergaitės tėvas Džimas.Laki yra labai nepatenkinta naujais namais. programme.title: galvOK
programme.desc: Žaidimas „galvOK“ tapo linksmu šeštadienio įpročiu – žiūrovai kviečiami praleisti vakarą prasmingai, atsakinėjant į neįtikėtinus, keistus, o kartais ir labai juokingus klausimus. Tačiau šį rudenį projektas grįžta atsinaujinęs – prie ilgamečio kapitono Manto Katlerio prisijungs azartiškasis žaidimų fanas Mindaugas Stasiulis. Kartu su laidos svečiais jie bandys atsakyti į kuo daugiau klausimų, o už kiekvieną teisingą atsakymą laimėtus pinigus pasidalinti su už nugaros sėdėjusiais žiūrovais. Puiki nuotaika, jaudinanti įtampa ir smagus šeštadienio vakaras kaip ir visuomet – garantuotas!

programme.title: Kaimynai
programme.desc: Rėjus Petersenas drauge su žmona gyvena ramiame priemiesčio rajone. Tačiau kartą ramus gyvenimas pasibaigė – į gretimą namą atsikraustė keisti kaimynai.Niekas nepastebėjo, kur dingo senieji gyventojai ir kaip įsikraustė nauji. Dabar naktimis iš namo sklinda keisti garsai. Trys kaimynai nusprendžia išsiaiškinti, kas dedasi tame sename name…

programme.title: Septynios seserys
programme.desc: Ateities pasaulis išgyvena populiacijos krizę, todėl šeimai leidžiama turėti tik vieną vaiką. Jei gimsta dvynukai ar trynukai, paliekamas vyriausias, kiti užmigdomi. Karen miršta gimdydama mergaičių septynetuką. Jų senelis, nenorėdamas skriausti nė vienos mergaitės, augina visas septynias, pavadina jas savaitės dienomis ir moko elgtis visas vienodai, kad prireikus galėtų vaidinti vieną merginą. Namuose jos būna savimi – septynios skirtingos seserys, bet kai prisireikia išeiti laukan, visos rengiasi ir dažosi it viena, ta pati mergina. Pirmadienei leidžiama išeiti pirmadieniais, Antradienei – antradieniais ir t.t. Grįžus reikia sesėms papasakoti viską, kas nutiko, kad nebūtų jokių spragų. Merginos puikiai laikosi senelio taisyklių, tačiau vieną dieną Pirmadienė negrįžta namo. Kas jai nutiko? Seserys nerimauja, bet nė viena iš jų negali išeiti iš namų ieškoti dingusios, nes taip jų paslaptis gali išaiškėti ir pražus jos visos. Ką daryti?Visas skirtingas septynias seseris talentingai įkūnijo švedų aktorė Noomi Rapace, žinoma iš filmų „Mergina su drakono tatuiruote“ ir „Šerlokas Holmsas. Šešėlių žaidimas“. Septynetuko senelį vaidina trims „Oskarams“ nominuotas Willemas Dafoe, o Vaikų paskirstymo biuro vadovę – net šešiems „Oskarams“ nominuotoji Glenn Close.
